item.title: [release-25.11] librechat: mark vulnerable
item.description:
We can't backport librechat updates because they depend on npmDepsFetcherVersion = 2 to build (which is only available on unstable, would require a backport of #470517). Version 0.8.0 is affected by two known CVEs that have been fixed by updates we currently can't backport. Three other CVEs have only been introduced in version 0.8.2/0.8.3 (and fixed after), they do not affect this version.

item.title: nixos/dhparams: deprecate, schedule removal
item.description:
Generating your own dhparams has been obsoleted by RFC 7919 (2016).

DHE itself has been obsoleted by ECHDE (RFC8422, 2018) and Hybrid PQ (draft-ietf-tls-ecdhe-mlkem, 2026) key exchanges.

TLS 1.3 (RFC8446, 2018) stopped defining any DHE cipher suites and lists this as a major difference from TLS 1.2.
